name: GL_COA_MAP_ROLLUP_RULES_INT
description: This interface table is used to import chart of accounts mapping rollup rules.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The action that the import process must perform. Valid values are INSERT and DELETE.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Rollup rule status code of the interface record.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created the row.

columns.name: COA_MAPPING_NAME
columns.description: User defined chart of accounts definition name.

columns.name: TO_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Target segment name identifier.

columns.name: TO_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Target segment value for the rollup rule.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT1_CODE
columns.description: First source segment identifier.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT1_CONDITION_CODE
columns.description: The operator to be used with the first source segment in the rollup rule.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT1_VALUE_LOW
columns.description: Low range value of the first source segment.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT1_VALUE_HIGH
columns.description: High range value of the first source segment.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT1_TREE_CODE
columns.description: Tree code of first source segment parent value.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT1_TREE_VERSION
columns.description: Tree version of first source segment parent value.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT2_CODE
columns.description: Second source segment identifier.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT2_CONDITION_CODE
columns.description: The operator to be used with the second source segment in the rollup rule.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT2_VALUE_LOW
columns.description: Low range value of the second source segment.

columns.name: FROM_SEGMENT2_VALUE_HIGH
columns.description: High range value of the second source segment.

columns.name: IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: The error message of the rules that could not be imported. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
